title: Bramley Apple Coq au Vin
description: A low-carb twist on the classic French dish, featuring tender chicken in a rich apple and red wine sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the butter to the skillet and melt. Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced apples and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they begin to soften.
Add the red wine to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Season with thyme and salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
